result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, the schema uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional()`, which evaluate to the literal property key '[object Object]'; z.string().toString() is not the string value. So minimumTokenResponseSchema only actually validates access_token, and parsed sync-mode responses would only retain access_token, dropping expiry/instance_url etc. Also parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the whole safeParse result and callers like O365/Zoom/Google use it directly. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff;
